verified_translation_edits: Created the complete Tamil text draft from the current English catalogue, including UI captions, help, hints, diagnostics, accessibility and original L2 text.
Directly authored or corrected more than 1,500 exact English keys, with consistent case variants. The remaining candidates came from a locally executed NLLB model.
Distinguished saved files from rescued lemmings and preserved retry, resume, end-run, undo and player-turn meanings in the directly reviewed action vocabulary.
Replaced both complete controller guides and all six flattened multiline messages. Retained binding names, line breaks and support limits.

Directly reviewed touch, drag, pinch, two-finger tap, press, hold, release and speed-control help. Added the four new accessibility/level-playlist templates. Corrected Playlist to mean a level list throughout.

Compared sentence boundaries and numbered-argument occurrence counts. Corrected detected dropped clauses, repeated arguments and degenerate model output, including the irreversible player-delete warning.
Corrected detected missing arguments, negation reversals, literal translations of Hot Seat, invalid-data errors, format tokens and game-title alterations.

Checked all current text and plural keys with the repository validator functions and the per-key unchanged list. No missing keys, placeholder errors, unsafe count formats, unexpected-script characters, newline differences or numeric protection markers remain.
Added the final nine accessibility/state templates after lettering implementation. Preserved all previous 3,121 translation values. Native language approval remains incomplete.

reviewed_scope.release_welcome_2_0_5: The 2.0.5 release-welcome page has 11 AI-drafted additions, restored from earlier 2.0 drafts where available. One obsolete entry was removed.

candidate.model_execution: Local Transformers inference. App text was not sent to an external translation service. Public weights and optional dependencies are confined to ignored .build scratch.
candidate.note: Local model candidates required direct corrections. The model dropped some first clauses and numbered arguments, flattened controller guides, mistranslated game terms and reversed some invalid-data wording. Remaining candidates still require full language review.
